notes: Implemented Phase 3 of the undo/redo review follow-ups plan: E2E tests for undo expansion. Created test/e2e/undo-redo.spec.js with 9 Playwright tests covering all major undoable action categories: add images, remove image, layout style change, layout options (gutter), title text, title formatting, background style, overlay, and multiple sequential undos. All 9 tests pass. Key E2E limitations discovered: @focus events don't fire reliably in headless Chromium (el.focus() does not dispatch focus event), @select events don't fire with Playwright's selectText(), page.fill() doesn't work on range inputs, sidebar sections are collapsed by default, and settings persist across test runs via localStorage. These limitations were documented in the plan file.
